name: Tutorial Tumble
story: The ancient training grounds echo with forgotten detonations. Welcome, rookie Bomber Runner.
Long ago, masters of the blast tested their courage in these tunnels.
Today you step where legends once danced with fire. Each crate hides a secret.
The old guardians watch from the shadows—prove your spark or be lost to the dust.
Light the fuse. Show the maze that the art of the bomb still lives in you.
game_over_story: The last echo of your blast fades. The maze exhales, unbeaten.
Your fuse burned bright, but the labyrinth’s heart still beats in darkness.
Shattered crates and silent corridors are all that remain of your charge.
The guardians reclaim the tunnels. Your spark is now a memory in the dust.
Defeat is only a pause—the bombs of tomorrow wait for your return.
